insights.topic: Type-safety cards form 50% of all blockages and are compounding
insights.suggestion: Unblock the P0 as-any removal (t_112b666a) as a critical path gate before any new type-unsafe code is merged; consider a paired mobbing session between devs to break the logjam rather than letting these pile up across two WS6 cards.
insights.evidence: 4 of 8 blocked cards are type-safety or as-any removal: t_112b666a (P0), t_cddfeb6b (P1), t_6756d4a5 (WS6), t_2308b540 (WS6). t_6756d4a5 and t_2308b540 have near-identical titles in the same workstream.

insights.topic: Duplicate or overlapping WS6 cards indicate backlog hygiene failure
insights.suggestion: Audit t_6756d4a5 and t_2308b540 — merge or mark one as a duplicate. Reconcile before the next sprint to avoid double-counting effort and confusing velocity metrics.
insights.evidence: t_6756d4a5 titled 'WS6 - Implement Infrastructure/Type Safety' and t_2308b540 titled 'WS6 - Implement Infrastructure/Type Safety improvements' are both blocked dev and share identical scope. Exact title match confirms overlap.

insights.topic: P0 priority card shipped with zero QA verification
insights.suggestion: Retroactively create a QA verification card for t_248a356c (logWarn utility) or add an inline test assertion in the utility's test suite. Define a policy: P0 deliverables must always have a QA verification artifact before merge.
insights.evidence: t_248a356c (P0 logWarn utility) completed and merged but 'no QA verification card exists'. No downstream QA card was ever created for this P0 item.

insights.topic: Both QA cards are pipeline-blocked on dev dependencies, creating a testing debt tail
insights.suggestion: Resolve the dev-blocked t_0492fc42 (WS1 Paper Trade multi-profile) before the QA card t_dbc4d817 can proceed, and clarify the WS5 implementation status of t_52533709 so t_d2734055 can be unblocked or re-prioritised.
insights.evidence: t_dbc4d817 (QA Verify WS1) blocked on dev completion of t_0492fc42 (also blocked dev). t_d2734055 (QA Verify WS5) blocked on t_52533709 whose status is listed as both 'done' (section header) and 'not done' (annotation). 40% of all QA work (2 of 5 QA cards) is stalled.

insights.topic: Health score of 100 masks 24% blockage rate — metric may only count red items
insights.suggestion: Extend the health calculation to include blocked-card ratio as a yellow/yellow-orange threshold (e.g., degrade to 'STABLE with warnings' when blocked > 15%). Expose blocked/stalled counts in the health report so the metric matches operational reality.
insights.evidence: health=100 STABLE reported Jul 6 with 8 blocked cards (24% of 34 total), 8 stalled items, 3 unverified deliveries, and 2 QA cards blocked. Only 0 red items prevented a degrade — the health metric ignores blockage and stall velocity entirely.
